ideas.pitch: An automated log parsing and incident investigation CLI tool that ingests messy server crash reports and outputs a ranked list of root causes with evidence.
ideas.problem_statement: Server Crash: Who Killed The Server? - Incident Investigation and Root-Cause Analysis
ideas.title: LogSleuth AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core competition format of Round 1 and Round 2 by giving judges an interactive tool to trace log anomalies, aligning with the incident troubleshooting theme.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that inspects error reports and server metrics to generate a comprehensive incident post-mortem report and verifiable recovery playbook.
ideas.problem_statement: Server Crash: Who Killed The Server? - Identify the most likely cause of failure, justify diagnosis, and recommend an effective recovery plan
ideas.title: AgenticPostMortem
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning autonomous data incident response architecture pattern, providing judges with an instant, justifiable diagnosis and recovery roadmap.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight server telemetry and log management system with built-in anomaly profiling to pinpoint exact crash moments.
ideas.problem_statement: Server Crash: Who Killed The Server? - Investigate a simulated server incident using organizer-provided logs and system information
ideas.title: ZerverTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven Smart India Hackathon winner by providing a dedicated, highly visual server log management dashboard tailored for technical investigations.

ideas.pitch: A localized interactive chatbot configured with system error dumps and documentation to assist engineers during high-pressure troubleshooting investigations.
ideas.problem_statement: Server Crash: Who Killed The Server? - Technical investigation challenge testing troubleshooting abilities and logical reasoning
ideas.title: RootCauseCopilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a painful validation problem for judges who have to grade multiple complex troubleshooting scenarios by letting them query the evidence interactively.

ideas.pitch: A security-focused telemetry agent that detects malicious payload executions or resource exhaustion attacks leading to server crashes.
ideas.problem_statement: Server Crash: Who Killed The Server? - Test server fundamentals and basic cybersecurity knowledge to identify root causes
ideas.title: SysGuard-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines basic cybersecurity knowledge with server fundamentals, directly addressing the core judging criteria for the technical investigation challenge.
